name: Lenet Pacheco
office: Valley County Water District, Member, Board of Directors

items.text: Lenet Pacheco has served on the Valley County Water District board since 2009. She chairs the Finance and Capital Improvements Committee. She serves as an alternate on the Administrative Committee. She says she advocates for safe, affordable, clean, and reliable water and supported pandemic relief policies. In 2020, the California Fair Political Practices Commission fined her and her campaign committees $9,000 for failing to file multiple campaign finance reports on time.
